meaning:
δι-άγω
[in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;]
1. to carry over.
2. Of time, to pass: βίον, 1Ti.2:2; absol., to live, before ἐν, Tit.3:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
